steps.prompt: Catch the bus home. It is 09:35. Allow 10 minutes to walk after the bus. You need to arrive by 10:15. Choose the cheapest service that gets you there in time.
steps.teach: Add walking time to each arrival before comparing eligible fares.
steps.example: A bus arriving at 08:00 plus a 10-minute walk reaches the destination at 08:10.
steps.hint: Add the walking time to each bus arrival. Compare fares only for services that arrive in time.
steps.worked: The local service reaches the destination at 10:10 and costs £1.25.

steps.title: Plan pancake batches
steps.prompt: Make 3 pancakes for each of 4 portions: 12 pancakes altogether. The pan holds 4 pancakes at a time. How many batches, including a part-full last batch?
steps.teach: Work out the requested total or difference, using the units in the question.
steps.example: Three groups of 2 items contain 6 items.
steps.hint: Compare your model with the quantities and units in the task.
steps.worked: The required quantity is 3 batches.

steps.title: Prepare Banana pancakes
steps.prompt: Open the recipe card. Arrange the preparation actions for this meal.
steps.teach: Think about which action depends on an earlier action.
steps.example: For a different task: put socks on before putting shoes on.
steps.hint: Which action can safely happen first? What needs to be ready before the next action?
steps.worked: Mash the bananas → Mix flour, milk and banana → Cook and turn the pancakes
steps.instruction: Tap an action, then its position. Use every action once.

steps.title: Measure the milk
steps.prompt: Use the jug to measure 0.6 litres of milk for this batch.
steps.teach: Convert the units, then position the scale marker.
steps.example: 0.1 litre equals 100 ml.
steps.hint: One litre is 1,000 ml. Tap a jug scale mark, then fine-tune if needed.
steps.worked: 0.6 litres = 600 ml.

steps.title: Set the recipe temperature
steps.prompt: Use the temperature supplied on the recipe card for the frying pan. Do not guess a real food-safety temperature.
steps.teach: Check which option meets the requirement before comparing its cost.
steps.example: A 4-seat ticket is too small for 5 people, even when cheaper.
steps.hint: Find the temperature beside the cooking method on the recipe card.
steps.worked: This fictional recipe specifies 160 °C.

steps.title: When will the meal be ready?
steps.prompt: Start Banana pancakes at 10:26. The recipe specifies 8 minutes. Set the finishing time.
steps.teach: Add the duration to the start time. Carry 60 minutes into the next hour.
steps.example: 08:45 plus 20 minutes is 09:05.
steps.hint: Compare your model with the quantities and units in the task.
steps.worked: The finish time is 10:34.

steps.title: Serve and tidy
steps.prompt: The meal is ready. Put these actions in a safe and useful order.
steps.teach: Think about which action depends on an earlier action.
steps.example: For a different task: put socks on before putting shoes on.
steps.hint: Which action can safely happen first? What needs to be ready before the next action?
steps.worked: Turn off the cooking equipment → Serve the meal → Wash the used equipment
